purpose: Local qualitative skill evaluation; no detector or authorship claim
authorization: User requested create/test/iterate/fix/test. Uses session subagents only; no external paid API or unattended automation.
model: Session model inherited by subagents; exact model build, sampling settings and token/charge metrics unavailable unless reported by tool.

conditions.actors: fresh fork_turns=none contexts; two batch actors, one per arm; same prompts; candidate reads frozen instructions and catalog; baseline reads no writing skill
conditions.known_confound: Host developer instructions already impose plain-language style on both arms; baseline is not an unprompted model. Cases in each actor batch share that actor context.
conditions.limits: One first attempt per prompt per frozen arm; retries only after relevant change, recorded separately.
conditions.isolation: Distinct paths and fresh actor contexts; source/task state are immutable files. No browser/backend state.
conditions.verifier: Independent fresh-context blinded reviewer plus deterministic constraint checks and root audit; no human quality review yet.
conditions.scope: Synthetic writing artifacts only; no external sends or publications.

accounting.session_usage: unknown; included in user session, not separately metered

timing_limit: No trustworthy per-case generation latency. First baseline started_at/finished_at cover file serialization, not model generation; excluded from comparisons. Other actor times are self-reported.
